verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. Both crop the cream product circle against the top-left canvas edges, which reads as a clumsy bleed. Both leave a large dead orange area at top right. In both, 'Out now.' is indented about 44px from the headline's left edge, so it is not aligned, and the oversized 'Try It' pill competes with the headline for attention. A is a little worse because its CTA sits only about 48px from the bottom edge, which makes the lower half feel cramped. B moves the text block and button up for a better bottom margin, although the headline then sits a little tight under the circle.
